pairings.nmcName: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Guwahati
pairings.evidence: Same institution: AIIMS Guwahati is the full expansion of the NMC row name. NMC row is an AIIMS (universityName 'Statutory Autonomous, AIIMS (Guwahati)', 50 UG seats), so it is NOT Gauhati Medical College, Guwahati — which exists as its own already-matched NMC row.
Name drift only (city suffix). NMC address 'R.K. Mission Road, Dhubri-783324, Assam' — the sole Dhubri MBBS college in the registry.

enrichment.name: AIIMS Guwahati
enrichment.source: NMC UG registry 2023 (raw/nmc_ug_2023.json: managementupdate 'Govt.', ugApproved 50, universityName 'Statutory Autonomous, AIIMS (Guwahati)'); city + website from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/All_India_Institute_of_Medical_Sciences,_Guwahati and https://aiimsguwahati.ac.in/ . NMC's city field for this row reads 'Assam' (a state, not a city) so it was not used. 'established' omitted: sources conflict (Wikipedia infobox 12 Jan 2020 vs. first MBBS session reported 12 Jan 2021).
